title: Face search grid: cheekbone width x eye shape
user_request_verbatim: 분산이 너무 커지지 않게 하는 방법은 없어? / 내가 선택해야하는 갯수가 너무 많으면 안된단 말야
source_idea: Two axes the operator named concretely - the face is too narrow, the eyes are too narrow - varied in three explicit steps each with everything else pinned, so each result is a named variation rather than one of hundreds of unrelated faces. No reference image: this searches for a new face rather than editing master #4.
